tools.name: extract_contacts
tools.description:
Crawl a website and extract emails, phone numbers, and social profiles.

    Args:
        website: The website URL to crawl (e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com").
        max_pages: Maximum number of pages to crawl (1-20).

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description:
Perform WHOIS + DNS + SPF/DMARC lookup for a domain.

    Args:
        domain: Domain name to look up (e.g. "example.com").
        include_dns: Include DNS records (A, MX, NS, TXT, etc.).
        include_security: Include SPF/DMARC email-security check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_contacts, lookup_domain · Private data: extract_contacts, lookup_domain · Public sink: lookup_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_contacts, lookup_domain · Private data: extract_contacts, lookup_domain · Public sink: lookup_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
